description: The store has no tempfile samples for the window. TEMPFILE has no density gate -- its series is dense, so 'no samples at all' is the only unusable case -- and it is SKIPPED rather than stored. Without this the payload would carry temp_write_avg/worst/p99 of 0.0, publishing a monitoring outage as a confident 'no temp writes', which is exactly what the AAS density gate exists to prevent on the other path.
